scale.basis: Artistic display scale, not a measured whole animal

relative_design_parameters.normalization: All ratios below use shoulder height H=1. They are starting design constraints, not paleontological measurements. Adjust only within ranges while preserving the frozen feature obligations.
relative_design_parameters.skeletal_ratio_note: The four male ratios above derive only from P1 HMV0940 Tables1–2; soft-tissue envelope can be slightly broader but must preserve the long taper and waist. Do not impose the artistic torso ratios as source measurements.

construction_guidance.torso: Hand-profiled longitudinal loft with shoulder/chest and pelvic contour transitions; no unmodified default ellipsoid body.
construction_guidance.head: Profile-driven male cranium and rostrum with cheek/temple planes; do not make a sphere with tusks attached.
construction_guidance.lower_jaw: Loft a structural skin-covered mandibular trough from cheek to narrow waist to broad shallow shovel; two distinct ivory tusk blades at the anterior end. Keep slight dish curvature and nonzero thickness.
construction_guidance.trunk: Continuous tapering swept sections with a gentle offset bend, not a chain of cylinders or unsupported ring ridges.
construction_guidance.limbs: Tapered profiled legs with controlled knee/ankle and foot transitions; avoid ball joints.
construction_guidance.ears: Thickness-bearing shaped fan surfaces, not floating triangles or huge African-elephant ears.
construction_guidance.detail: Eye in a restrained socket plane, simple nails and optional small tail tuft as artistic choices. No fossil cracks or preserved-bone colours on the living model.

resolved_design.notes: Soft-tissue and pose dimensions are artistic, not measurements of HMV0940. Four reference skeletal ratios remain input guides rather than claims of bone exactness.
